description: Danmarks Statistik: energy datasets is a collection of datasets listed in Datavejviser.dk, a catalogue harvested into the European data portal, published or maintained by Danmarks Statistik. Coverage: Danmarks Statistik. The listing groups 4 datasets under this publisher or service host whose titles are about energy; the first few are linked and all are named in the audit file. Examples: Vedvarende energis andel af det samlede bruttoenergiforbrug; Vedvarende energis andel af energiforbruget efter land; Værdien af olie og naturgas efter balanceposter; Fysisk balance for naturgasreserverne efter balanceposter. Formats seen: CSV, JSON, XML, XLSX, HTML. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is CC-BY-4.0. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support energy network and generation-capacity studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-eu-datavejviser.
